claims: BenchUtilization is a distinct project-registered Coach candidate with prior evidence; no new Native test conducted.
External observations support concepts but do not certify CPU playbook selection, substitution, tempo or defense causal formula.
conflicts: Substitution bias, fatigue, 5 foul status, injury and lineup rotations confound BenchUtilization effect.
User manual coaching suggestions, ACE automatic actions and CPU-vs-CPU behaviors must remain distinct.
metrics: two source-native getter snapshots with exact program/build
separate actual 3D game statistics from settings claims
